scope: In-universe Arda events and calendar observances only

audit_summary.chronology_2022: Complete user-supplied PDF checked at listed S3 pages; S3 manuscript variants do not override final published dates
audit_summary.working_chronology_review: 19 selected manuscript cards replaced: 5 winter scenes, 3 river scenes, 11 independently checked lore events.
audit_summary.sixteen_card_review: 14 retained at supported temporal precision; two replaced by primary-supported Second Age cards.
audit_summary.source_passage_audit_scope: The 366 selected display cards, not the unused research catalogue
audit_summary.final_twenty_card_review: 15 date anchors retained; five cards corrected to supported periods.

date_convention: Month-day keys follow the cited narrative/chronology; they are not asserted to be Gregorian conversions of historical Arda dates. Named Shire days have approximate modern associations only.

display_guidance.dated: On another day, explicitly state the true source month/day and Arda year in yesterday/tomorrow/this-week/this-month copy. Recompute the schedule for each civil year; verify primary text before publication.
display_guidance.reconstructed: Always label reconstructed dates as such, including when shifted.
display_guidance.manuscript: Working-chronology-only dates remain in the research catalogue but are excluded from the displayed 366-card rotation.
display_guidance.calendar_association: Show the named observance and say its modern association is approximate.
display_guidance.broad: Events without an explicit Gregorian day show only a sourced season, midsummer, Yule, or approximate period. The position in the annual rotation is editorial.
display_guidance.unmapped: Keep out of daily rotation until a calendar mapping or relative anchor is chosen.
display_guidance.editorial_lore: Use once per annual rotation after dated and broad material. Before Time, Before the Years, Before the Sun, and year-only Second Age events have no annual month/day association. Separately sourced Second Age seasonal events are bounded to their stated season.
